name: The Keith household at 1900 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_keith_elbridge_g

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1900 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1900 Mr. & Mrs. Elbridge G. Keith; Stanley Keith; Harold Keith.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1900, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The four live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Earl Keith (a grown son the 1904 Blue Book does not list at the house); Bessie Keith (the one daughter at home in 1900, so very likely the Blue Book's "Miss Keith"; named in that line's note). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Elbridge G. Keith
persons.printed_as: 1900 Mr. & Mrs. Elbridge G. Keith & dr.
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Eldridge G. Keith here as head, born July 1840, in Vermont, married, bank president (ED 40, sheet 5A, line 2, leaf n802).

persons.name: Mrs. Elbridge G. Keith
persons.printed_as: 1900 Mr. & Mrs. Elbridge G. Keith & dr.
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Harriet Keith here as wife, born 1843, in Illinois, married (ED 40, sheet 5A, line 3, leaf n802).

persons.name: Miss Keith
persons.printed_as: 1900 Mr. & Mrs. Elbridge G. Keith & dr.
persons.note: The Blue Book prints '& dr.' after the household's name: an unmarried daughter at home, not named. 'Miss Keith' is the book's own form of address, not a recorded name. The 1900 census lists the unmarried daughter at home as Bessie Keith (born August 1878, in Illinois, single; ED 40, sheet 5A, line 5, leaf n802). She is very likely the one the book means, but the book does not say.

persons.name: Stanley Keith
persons.note: First listed at 1900 in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), under his parents; that he is their son is read from the listing, which does not state it. Whether he lived here on 1 July 1904 is not documented. The 1900 census lists Stanley Keith here as son, born July 1879 (the figures are hard to read), in Illinois, single (ED 40, sheet 5A, line 6, leaf n802).

persons.name: Harold Keith
persons.note: First listed at 1900 in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), under his parents; that he is their son is read from the listing, which does not state it. Whether he lived here on 1 July 1904 is not documented. The 1900 census lists Harold Keith here as son, born October 1881, in Illinois, single, at school (ED 40, sheet 5A, line 7, leaf n802).
